name: std::expected<T,E>::operator bool, std::expected<T,E>::has_value

declarations.code: constexpr explicit operator bool() const noexcept;

intro: Checks whether *this represents an expected value.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A std::expected object is never valueless. If has_value() returns true, operator*() can be used to access the expected value; otherwise, error() can be used to access the unexpected value.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: One result contains 42. Another contains the error message “Missing input”.

summary: Checks whether *this represents an expected value.
